text:
Her spiritual right hand upon a psalter,
solemn and taciturn,
a woman keeps watch in the mystery
of the night hour.

A great forest of symbols surrounds her.
Over her devout brow, flooded
with otherworldly brightness,
the temple's vast Gothic arches
cast their net. Winged powers
fill the broad shadowy naves;
on the white marble of tomb slabs
rest indolent statues, reclining
amid garlands of eternal roses.

Beside the burnished cedar doors
that guard the sanctuary's deathlike rest,
on friezes and moldings, fabulous
beasts mingle in hieratic poses.

Beneath the white of her stole
she meditates, white, alone,
solemn. She seems to embody
the three Theological Virtues;
zodiacal signs in a circle
halo her violet hair.

Feathers and gems of iridescent sheen
constellate her heavy robe;
her ringed, golden, spiritual right hand
rests on the instrument,
and at her feet a Latin pontiff
slowly and rhythmically swings
a fragile censer of fine gold.

translation.title: Vas spirituale
